HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   C. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   C. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.

   C. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

5. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.

   D. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

7. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat National Security as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

10. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.

11. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   B. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   D. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

13. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   D. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   B. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.

   C. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Political developments in independent Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Internal conflicts in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain French Revolutions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain The 2nd Generation of Industrial revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Conflict, Transformation and Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
